name: 5-Minute Breath Focus
script_short: Sit comfortably. Close your eyes. Inhale deeply for 4 counts, hold for 4, exhale for 4. Repeat. Focus only on the sound of your breath.

name: 10-Minute Body Scan
script_short: Lie down. Bring attention to your toes, then slowly move up to your head. Release tension in each part as you breathe out.
